name: City Crops Agro Ltd.
summary: City Crops Agro Ltd. specializes in the global commerce of seeds and diverse agricultural commodities, encompassing their import, export, and general trading. Its portfolio of farm produce features staples like rice and wheat, as well as vegetables such as potatoes and tomatoes. The firm also operates an e-commerce platform, providing access to a variety of cereals, oilseeds, pulses, and fresh produce. Furthermore, it undertakes contract-based manufacturing for agricultural goods, including cucumber, onion, and castor. The company was established on April 2, 2013, and its main office is situated in Ahmedabad, India.
